scr_fixed_assets_draft_assets_list.purpose: Lists draft assets captured from incoming capital invoices, with source invoice, amount, suggested class and property, so the accountant can review, correct and select them for activation.
scr_fixed_assets_draft_assets_list.outcome: A monthly queue of capital items to activate, reviewed before the depreciation run.
scr_fixed_assets_draft_assets_list.rootCause: The draft list is the control point where automatically captured capital spend is checked against the capitalization policy — for example rejecting a $900 appliance repair captured as capital because it was coded to a capital GL line.
scr_fixed_assets_draft_assets_list.ifSkipped: Routine repairs get capitalized automatically, or genuine capital items never leave draft status.
redFlags: Drafts below the capitalization threshold
Drafts with suggested classes that do not match the invoice description

scr_fixed_assets_periodic_tasks.purpose: Periodic Tasks section of the All tab, centred on Post Depreciation — the monthly job that turns asset schedules into GL entries.
scr_fixed_assets_periodic_tasks.outcome: Depreciation is posted every period as part of the close checklist.
scr_fixed_assets_periodic_tasks.rootCause: Depreciation has no effect until posted. Grouping it as a periodic task anchors it in the monthly close so it is not left for year-end.
scr_fixed_assets_periodic_tasks.ifSkipped: Months of depreciation are missing until a year-end catch-up.
redFlags: Depreciation not on the monthly close checklist

scr_fixed_assets_depreciation_batches_li.purpose: Lists depreciation batches by period and location, used to post depreciation journal entries for one or more locations and to review or delete batches already created.
scr_fixed_assets_depreciation_batches_li.outcome: A record of which periods and properties have depreciation posted, and a way to post missing ones.
scr_fixed_assets_depreciation_batches_li.rootCause: In large portfolios some properties get missed in a month. The batch list shows gaps by property and period so none are skipped.
scr_fixed_assets_depreciation_batches_li.ifSkipped: Individual properties silently miss depreciation for a period.
redFlags: Properties with a gap in batch periods

scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation_jo.purpose: Posts depreciation for the period for all locations or selected locations, generating the depreciation JE per location and book.
scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation_jo.outcome: Depreciation entries land in the GL for the chosen scope and period.
scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation_jo.rootCause: Posting by selected locations lets accountants post properties whose assets are ready while holding back properties with pending draft activations or disposals.
scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation_jo.ifSkipped: Depreciation is posted before activations and disposals are processed, requiring corrections.
redFlags: All-locations posting run while some locations have unprocessed drafts

scr_fixed_assets_previewing_assets_not_d.purpose: Before posting, previews assets that should have depreciated in earlier months but did not — typically because they were activated late with a past in-service date — so catch-up depreciation can be reviewed.
scr_fixed_assets_previewing_assets_not_d.outcome: Catch-up depreciation is identified and reviewed before it posts in one month.
scr_fixed_assets_previewing_assets_not_d.rootCause: Late activation of assets with earlier in-service dates produces catch-up depreciation that can distort a single month. Previewing it lets the accountant decide whether it is immaterial or needs disclosure to the reviewer.
scr_fixed_assets_previewing_assets_not_d.ifSkipped: Unexpected depreciation spikes appear in the month without explanation to the asset manager.
redFlags: Large catch-up amounts posted without reviewer awareness

scr_fixed_assets_viewing_depreciation_ba.purpose: Opens a posted depreciation batch to see the amounts by asset and GL account for a location and period.
scr_fixed_assets_viewing_depreciation_ba.outcome: The depreciation entry can be traced to individual assets.
scr_fixed_assets_viewing_depreciation_ba.rootCause: Reviewers and auditors ask why depreciation changed month over month; batch detail shows which assets were added or fully depreciated.
scr_fixed_assets_viewing_depreciation_ba.ifSkipped: Depreciation changes cannot be explained at asset level.
redFlags: Batch totals not matching the GL entry

scr_fixed_assets_deleting_depreciation_b.purpose: Deletes a depreciation batch — for example one posted before draft assets were activated or before a disposal — so it can be re-run correctly.
scr_fixed_assets_deleting_depreciation_b.outcome: An incorrect depreciation posting is removed and recalculated.
scr_fixed_assets_deleting_depreciation_b.rootCause: Posting order errors are common. Deleting and re-running the batch is cleaner than manual correcting JEs, but only while the period is open.
scr_fixed_assets_deleting_depreciation_b.ifSkipped: Incorrect depreciation is corrected by manual JEs that break the tie between batches and the register.
redFlags: Batches deleted in periods already reported to the owner

scr_fixed_assets_reports.purpose: Reports section of Fixed Assets — Asset Info reports (accumulated depreciation, disposals, activity, register) and the Asset Reconciliation report.
scr_fixed_assets_reports.outcome: Fixed-asset evidence for the close package, audit and tax preparation.
scr_fixed_assets_reports.rootCause: Auditors, tax preparers and buyers in due diligence all require asset reports; the reconciliation report is the monthly control.
scr_fixed_assets_reports.ifSkipped: Fixed-asset balances go unsupported in the close and audit.
redFlags: Reports not retained with close evidence

scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_reports.purpose: Runs the asset information reports — Accumulated Depreciation, Asset Disposal, Asset Activity and asset listings — by location, class, book and date range.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_reports.outcome: Asset-level detail for roll-forwards, tax schedules (e.g., Form 4562 inputs) and audit requests.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_reports.rootCause: Year-end tax preparation needs additions and disposals by class and in-service date; audits need roll-forward detail. These reports provide it without manual compilation.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_reports.ifSkipped: Tax preparers and auditors receive manually compiled lists that do not tie to the register.
redFlags: Reports run on the GAAP book when the tax preparer needs the tax book

scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.purpose: Sets parameters (report type, locations, classes, book, date range) and runs an asset info report for viewing or export.
scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.outcome: A correctly scoped asset report for the question being answered.
scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.rootCause: Wrong parameters (wrong book or date range) are the usual reason asset reports fail to tie to the GL.
scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.ifSkipped: Reports are run with default parameters and do not match the period under review.
redFlags: Date range not matching the period being reconciled

scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_report_colum.purpose: Defines the columns in asset info reports — asset ID, description, class, location, in-service date, cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value, disposal date and proceeds.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_report_colum.outcome: Users interpret asset reports correctly for roll-forwards and tax schedules.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_report_colum.rootCause: Tax preparers rely on in-service date and cost columns to compute MACRS and bonus depreciation; misreading them causes tax errors.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_info_report_colum.ifSkipped: Tax depreciation inputs are wrong, affecting partner K-1s.
gaap: IRC §168(k) — bonus depreciation by placed-in-service date
redFlags: Missing in-service dates in report output

scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.purpose: Compares asset balances in the register (cost and accumulated depreciation by account) with GL balances to verify they agree, listing differences by account.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.outcome: The monthly register-to-GL tie-out work paper for fixed assets.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.rootCause: Asset accounts are easily hit by entries outside Fixed Assets (A/P invoices coded to 1530, manual JEs). This report is how those breaks are found every month rather than at audit.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.ifSkipped: Register and GL diverge, and year-end audit finds unsupported asset balances.
redFlags: Differences carried forward month after month

scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.purpose: Chooses the parameters (locations, as-of date, book, accounts) and runs the asset reconciliation report.
scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.outcome: A reconciliation scoped exactly to the period-end being closed.
scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.rootCause: Running the reconciliation with the wrong as-of date or book produces false differences and wasted investigation time.
scr_fixed_assets_customizing_and_running.ifSkipped: False variances are investigated or real ones are missed.
redFlags: As-of date not equal to period end

scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.purpose: Explains the reconciliation report columns — account, register balance, GL balance, difference — for cost and accumulated depreciation.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.outcome: Preparers know whether a difference is in cost (missing asset) or accumulated depreciation (missing posting or disposal).
scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.rootCause: A cost difference points to additions not in the register; an accumulated-depreciation difference points to unposted depreciation or disposals. The columns direct the investigation.
scr_fixed_assets_asset_reconciliation_re.ifSkipped: Investigations start in the wrong place and take longer.
redFlags: Differences only in accumulated depreciation after a disposal month

scr_fixed_assets_about_the_fixed_assets_.purpose: Quick Steps overview of Fixed Assets for users who need the essentials: classes define rules, assets carry cost and dates, drafts come from invoices, depreciation posts monthly, and reconciliation proves it all ties.
scr_fixed_assets_about_the_fixed_assets_.outcome: A fast orientation for accountants covering a property's fixed assets for the first time.
scr_fixed_assets_about_the_fixed_assets_.rootCause: Offshore accountants often inherit properties mid-year and must run the fixed-asset routine immediately. A condensed overview gives them the flow without the full manual.
scr_fixed_assets_about_the_fixed_assets_.ifSkipped: New accountants skip activation or reconciliation steps in their first closes.
redFlags: First-month closes with no fixed-asset activity at active properties

scr_fixed_assets_setting_up_asset_classe.purpose: Quick Steps for creating asset classes with depreciation method, life and GL accounts per book.
scr_fixed_assets_setting_up_asset_classe.outcome: Classes set up quickly and consistently with policy.
scr_fixed_assets_setting_up_asset_classe.rootCause: Setting up classes correctly is a one-time task with long-lasting effects; a short guide keeps the key fields (life, method, accounts, books) front of mind.
scr_fixed_assets_setting_up_asset_classe.ifSkipped: Classes are set up with missing books or wrong accounts.
redFlags: Classes missing a tax book

scr_fixed_assets_adding_a_new_asset.purpose: Quick Steps for adding a single asset — class, cost, location, in-service date — applying the owner's capitalization threshold before deciding to capitalize.
scr_fixed_assets_adding_a_new_asset.outcome: A new capital item is registered and starts depreciating from the right month.
scr_fixed_assets_adding_a_new_asset.rootCause: Every asset addition is a capitalization decision. The quick path reminds the user of the threshold and useful-life test so routine repairs are not capitalized.
scr_fixed_assets_adding_a_new_asset.ifSkipped: Repairs are capitalized, understating expense and overstating assets.
gaap: Treas. Reg. §1.263(a)-1(f) — de minimis safe harbor
redFlags: Assets below the capitalization threshold

scr_fixed_assets_disposing_or_partially_.purpose: Quick Steps for disposing of an asset or part of it when a component is replaced, destroyed or sold, recording the disposal date and any proceeds.
scr_fixed_assets_disposing_or_partially_.outcome: Replaced components come off the books when the new component goes on.
scr_fixed_assets_disposing_or_partially_.rootCause: Component replacement is constant in multifamily. The quick path makes disposal a routine companion to capitalization rather than a forgotten year-end task.
scr_fixed_assets_disposing_or_partially_.ifSkipped: The register carries both old and new components.
redFlags: Replacements capitalized with no disposal

scr_fixed_assets_disposing_of_assets_in_.purpose: Quick Steps for disposing of many assets at once for a property sale, casualty event or program-wide component replacement.
scr_fixed_assets_disposing_of_assets_in_.outcome: Mass disposals recorded consistently with one date and reason.
scr_fixed_assets_disposing_of_assets_in_.rootCause: Sales and casualties affect many assets at once; a short guide speeds the process under closing deadlines.
scr_fixed_assets_disposing_of_assets_in_.ifSkipped: Sold properties keep assets on the register.
redFlags: Disposal date not matching the sale closing date

scr_fixed_assets_transferring_an_asset.purpose: Quick Steps for transferring an asset between locations, moving its cost and accumulated depreciation to the receiving property.
scr_fixed_assets_transferring_an_asset.outcome: Assets are reported at the property that uses them.
scr_fixed_assets_transferring_an_asset.rootCause: Shared equipment moves between sister properties; transfers keep each owner's books right.
scr_fixed_assets_transferring_an_asset.ifSkipped: Depreciation charged to the wrong property and owner.
redFlags: Transfers across different owners without billing

scr_fixed_assets_reclassing_an_asset.purpose: Quick Steps for moving an asset to a different GL account when it was misclassified (e.g., appliances booked to building improvements).
scr_fixed_assets_reclassing_an_asset.rootCause: Misclassification at invoice entry is common; a quick reclass path keeps the register aligned with the GL.
scr_fixed_assets_reclassing_an_asset.ifSkipped: Asset categories and lives are misstated.
redFlags: Reclass without matching life change

scr_fixed_assets_activating_draft_assets.purpose: Quick Steps for selecting reviewed draft assets and activating them into the live register before the month's depreciation run.
scr_fixed_assets_activating_draft_assets.outcome: Captured capital items start depreciating in the correct month.
scr_fixed_assets_activating_draft_assets.rootCause: Activation must precede posting depreciation each month; the short guide reinforces the sequence.
scr_fixed_assets_activating_draft_assets.ifSkipped: Assets start depreciating late, creating catch-up entries.
redFlags: Drafts activated after depreciation posted for the month

scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation.purpose: Quick Steps for the monthly depreciation posting: confirm drafts and disposals are processed, choose locations and period, post, and verify the batch.
scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation.outcome: Monthly depreciation posted accurately in one pass.
scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation.rootCause: Depreciation is posted every month across many properties; a quick checklist prevents posting out of sequence.
scr_fixed_assets_posting_depreciation.ifSkipped: Depreciation posted before activations, requiring rework.
redFlags: Batch posted with pending drafts

scr_fixed_assets_running_asset_info_repo.purpose: Quick Steps for running asset info reports for audit, tax or roll-forward needs.
scr_fixed_assets_running_asset_info_repo.outcome: Fast production of asset detail for requests.
scr_fixed_assets_running_asset_info_repo.rootCause: Audit and tax requests arrive under deadline; a quick guide gets the right report with the right book and dates.
redFlags: GAAP-book reports sent to tax preparers
